coverage_rest.why: a weighted deck is a pure rule; 200 seeded draws offline prove split, cap and no duplicates more cheaply than any staging
the hardpoint uses the same powered comp; one extra powering step in the Repulsor scene covers it
flight is never live-tested without him; a def and frame read is the check allowed
a switch sweep is a checklist, not a face
the tooling is what runs every scene; the walk exercises it end to end

defs only, their event belongs to EnvironmentalHazards and TheForge
